Adding an open coordinate slab containing the hole forces a Bang signed-sum witness inside the outer orthotope and outside every covering plank. Explicit coordinate-strip and shortest-side covers attain both bounds. For planar strict-phase equality, R_j>=gap_j and budget conservation force equality; the strict two-coordinate inequality rules out every oblique plank, and an uncovered-coordinate argument forces exact exterior-interval partitions. The exact-rational checker validates sample identities but is not used for infinite quantification.

value.rationale: The entire family of arbitrary-aspect-ratio orthotope annuli has a natural yet non-affine-invariant Euclidean plank-covering threshold, with a sharp, dimension-free transition from full-width preservation to exposed-coordinate-strip coverings. The planar rigidity component completely identifies optimal configurations for nonsquare rectangles. These are a complete natural geometric classification and a motivated equality structure, not an arbitrary numerical sample or a mere rewording of the known cube theorem; the known square specialization and imported lemmas are explicitly credited.
